node.statement: For U_1={j_1}, node 1.1 gives A_{U_1} as an extended epsilon_{U_1}-C*-algebra for epsilon_{U_1}=W.L*epsilon. The one-dimensional atomic-image hypothesis gives dim A_{U_1}=1. Put t_atom=W.K_call*epsilon; then epsilon_{U_1} <= t_atom <= W.r_reset. By lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion and the uniform call certification in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, the scalar map u_0:C=M_1->A_{U_1} is a bijective extended D_*t_atom-inclusion, has unit error at most D_*t_atom, and is an eligible explicit raw call.
